messages:
Eli: EOD handoff — mainline cut scheduled in ~45m. Current slate: 3 cherrypicks waiting (two small fixes, one perf tweak). CI green for main but flaky on canary GPUs.
Priya: looking now, which PRs are blocking the cut? can review the small fixes.
Eli: PRs: #4821 (kafka consumer offset fix), #4833 (hotfix: token cache), #4839 (batching perf change). #4839 needs perf numbers, might be risky.
Jordan: I can take #4821 and #4833 review now. tagging @Nadia for #4839 perf numbers — last run on canary failed at seq_len 1024.
Nadia: saw the failure, repro locally. I captured the trace; seems kernel fallback on cuda causes 2x latency spike. Working on a micro-benchmark. ETA ~1.5h. :clock1:
Eli: ok — if #4839 not cleared before cut we should revert and ship the two safe fixes. prefer not to block main for perf refactor.
Jordan: re: approvals — @Priya can you approve #4821 and #4833 so we can merge if CI stays green?
Priya: approved #4821 and #4833. left a small nit on #4833 but not blocking. :+1:
deploy-bot: CI: main branch tests passed (build 2874). Canary GPU job failed: gpu-canary-23 (seq_len 1024) — https://ci.internal/runs/2879
Eli: thanks bot. Jordan — can you re-run the canary once Nadia has the micro-benchmark fix? want to avoid noisy failures.
Jordan: will re-queue after Nadia posts update. command I use:
```
ci requeue --job gpu-canary-23 --priority high
```
Eli: also quick note — if cut slides, inform support and update release-notes draft (I updated the PR with the current bullets).
Nadia: micro-benchmark shows the fallback path is triggered by a padding edgecase; putting a guard now, will push a tiny patch to #4839.
Eli: perfect. if patch looks small and CI stays green, aim to merge pre-cut. if not, revert #4839 and proceed.
Priya: I'll monitor post-merge runs. ping me in thread if anything weird.
Jordan: requeue done once Nadia pushes. leaving a calendar note for cut T+0 to notify infra team. :calendar:
